subject.title: [Feature]: [Feishu] Card header/footer customization: hide agent label, show elapsed time & completion status, support reply-to context

question: What Feishu card presentation/config contract should OpenClaw support for headers, note footers, elapsed/status display, and reply-context headers?
rationale: The issue would add durable channel config and change visible Feishu message metadata; repository policy treats config/default additions and plugin presentation contracts as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Define one Feishu card contract
options.body: Add one plugin-owned config shape covering header mode, footer fields, elapsed/status behavior, and default compatibility for static and streaming cards.

options.title: Land narrow footer customization first
options.body: Accept a small custom-footer option while keeping elapsed/status, reply-context headers, and hiding behavior tracked separately.

options.title: Defer presentation knobs
options.body: Keep current identity header/footer behavior until maintainers decide this Feishu config surface is worth supporting.

recommendation.title: Define one Feishu card contract
recommendation.body: Add one plugin-owned config shape covering header mode, footer fields, elapsed/status behavior, and default compatibility for static and streaming cards.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman merged and followed up on the structured-card work, so they are the clearest history-backed owner for the product-shape decision.
